text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, gasp, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(In the first half... I pushed a little too hard.
I thought at that pace, it would be manageable, but...)
choice_data_list: Let's adjust the workload for now.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: No, but still—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Please do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the mock race, Rose Kingdom's
condition had been steadily deteriorating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A great deal happened between winter and early spring.
And amid all of that, came that crushing defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She already carried such a heavy burden.
Perhaps the exhaustion in both mind and body
had simply caught up with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I made my support
even more thorough. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the meals you have been preparing for me lately...
It seems the number of dishes has increased, has it not?
choice_data_list: A few side dishes to help recover from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see, thank you.
However, please do so only within reason.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: "Right before the Takarazuka Kinen, and aren't there rather a lot of days off?"
choice_data_list: I configured it in consideration of the current situation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see, understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, however,
the subtle dip in her condition still lingered.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: After our break comes strength training, correct...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Before that, could we perhaps add
some cornering training to the regimen?
choice_data_list: I'm afraid... I cannot permit that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen just ahead, I wanted to avoid any buildup of fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, in the Takarazuka Kinen,
cornering is one of the key factors put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, but power to surge up the steep hill
is also essential... Yet neither can be called sufficient.
I must become stronger, much more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I showed her the recorded times.
While it might not be entirely smooth sailing,
the graph unmistakably traced an upward growth curve.
choice_data_list: It's all right. Let's stay calm and take our time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ............Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never had she shown such desperation,
not even before that Arima Kinen
which had brought on her illness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps the situation is even more grave than I had perceived.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Hm?
choice_data_list: I'm planning to schedule a slightly longer break soon.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: At this time of year...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One could hardly say her current conditioning was adequate.
Even so, I could not simply leave her to her own devices.
choice_data_list: Why not visit your family home and recharge your batteries?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she stepped away from Tracen Academy and its deep ties to the racing world,
returning to a peaceful sanctuary—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It may help encourage physical and mental relaxation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is still so much left to be done.
I was just painfully reminded
of how lacking my own strength truly is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This is my most heartfelt, humble request."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As I continued, she eventually gave a subtle nod.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
('A favor,' was it...? Had I looked
so fragile as to make them say that?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...How pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Still... it truly brings peace to my heart.
The fragrance, the very air...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(It is a thoughtful proposal.
I must devote myself to resting body and mind.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—Wait, that's...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (The Wise King Moss...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...How nostalgic.
You and I were always together.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We spoke of so many things back then.
Stories of your life, and tales of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
Wise King Moss.
Someday, I too shall become like you.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text: With these legs, I will shatter our curse and lead my house to a radiant future. I swear it!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...*Munch*.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I am weak.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: There is so much that I still lack.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Can I truly become a king who leads a nation...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I want to be... just like you, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Do not weep, do not waver—be strong.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(If you wish to lead all:
believe in your own strength and achieve everything.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It has been some time.
...Thank you for arranging my leave.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It seems I truly was a bit fatigued. Taking a rest has filled me with renewed vitality.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Therefore, worry no longer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall make this race one that leads the Rose Kingdom
toward a dazzling future.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Grand Prix race begins once again this year!
The Takarazuka Kinen—!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: As expected, the number one choice in the fan vote! Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash and Rulership, who adorned the greatest generation of last year's Classic campaign!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan, having claimed a brilliant victory in the GII following the New Year,
and the Grand Prix champion, Dream Journey!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And now—surging forward bearing the proud name of the House of the Rose, here is Rose Kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Neither my spirit nor my strength is worthy of a monarch.
That much... I understand all too well.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, let my resolve remain steadfast.
Without faltering, without wavering, I shall forge ahead.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(If I do, it can be achieved.
I can guide the Rose Kingdom into peace and prosperity—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Through victory, I shall seize it with my own hands.
The dazzling future of our kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Amid roaring fervor,
the curtain rises on the Grand Prix race!
